payload.body: nahel install crashed with unhandled EISDIR when the shim directory contained a directory named *.md: listMarkdownDocs classified entries by name suffix alone (bare readdir), so directory entries flowed into the prune loop's unlink; removeFile deliberately swallows only ENOENT/ENOTDIR. Fixed by listing withFileTypes and excluding directory entries — a directory is not a markdown doc. Symlinks still pass; deleting directories stays outside the store's file-scoped delete primitive. Shipped in PR #15.
